description: The line plot illustrates the loss values over the number of iterations for different training configurations, with the x-axis labeled as "#Iteration" ranging from 95,000 to 125,000 on a linear scale, and the y-axis labeled "Loss" ranging from 2.0 to 2.8, also on a linear scale. The plot includes four distinct lines: a pink dashed line representing "SepLLM (n=64, larger lr)", a blue solid line for "SepLLM (n=128)", an orange solid line for "SepLLM (n=64)", and a red dashed line for "Vanilla before post-training". All four lines start at a loss value of approximately 2.9 at 95,000 iterations and exhibit a general downward trend as the number of iterations increases. The pink line begins at 2.9 and decreases to approximately 2.2 by 125,000 iterations. The blue line starts at 2.9 and decreases to about 2.25. The orange line starts at 2.9 and decreases to around 2.25. The red line remains relatively flat, starting at 2.4 and ending at approximately 2.35. The red line is consistently below the other three lines after the initial point, indicating a lower loss value throughout the range.
